beats: Every new snack meant re-reading the label and typing in its carb count by hand.
Even for a product already measured months ago — the work never got saved.
And nothing stopped Artem from quietly changing a number his doctor relied on.
Now one photo of the label is enough.
AI vision reads the carbs and files the product under its own category.
Measured once, that snack's carbs are ready every time it comes back.
